pre_outcome_metric_conventions.annualized_one_way_turnover: sum(0.5 * sum(abs(target_weight - pre_trade_weight))) / elapsed_years; matches src/parayabuck/execution/telemetry.py
pre_outcome_metric_conventions.filled_target_notional_ratio: decision-notional weighted order quantity completion: each full union(target, pre-trade) absolute-delta notional is multiplied by filled_qty/requested_qty; no-order band/minimum deltas receive zero completion; open-price gaps cannot change completion
pre_outcome_metric_conventions.positive_gross_profit: sum of positive closed holding-episode gross P&L, including episode dividends and before slippage, spread, and fees; entity aggregation is used only for G8
pre_outcome_metric_conventions.contribution_identity: stable entity_id; ticker aliases are aggregated before G8 and all aliases are omitted in the prespecified dominant-entity run
pre_outcome_metric_conventions.g9_mapping: target allocation <= 0.55; realized gross <= 0.60; realized cash >= 0.40; actual positions <= 6; architecture parity must pass

pre_outcome_execution_conventions.partial_residual_policy: expire after the contracted first tradable session; never carry to a later session
pre_outcome_execution_conventions.cash_dividend_duplicate_key_policy: first canonical CSV occurrence wins, matching load_csv_corporate_actions
